title: My family
simplified_paragraphs: B：好久不见！你也来这家饭店吃饭？
A：对，我和我的家人来吃饭。我的朋友说这里的广东菜很好吃。
B：你的爸爸妈妈也来了吗？
A：没有，他们喜欢在家吃。我的孩子们来了。那是我的老公，小孙；那个是我的大儿子，小宝，今年7岁了；这是我的小女儿，小贝，今年5岁了。
B：你们一家四口人真幸福！孩子们都上学了吗？
A：大儿子去年上小学了，小女儿明年上小学。
traditional_paragraphs: B：好久不見！你也來這家飯店吃飯？
A：對，我和我的家人來吃飯。我的朋友說這裡的廣東菜很好吃。
B：你的爸爸媽媽也來了嗎？
A：沒有，他們喜歡在家吃。我的孩子們來了。那是我的老公，小孫；那個是我的大兒子，小寶，今年7歲了；這是我的小女兒，小貝，今年5歲了。
B：你們一家四口人真幸福！孩子們都上學了嗎？
A：大兒子去年上小學了，小女兒明年上小學。
pinyin_paragraphs: A： Wáng lǎo shī， hǎo jiǔ bu jiàn！
B： hǎo jiǔ bu jiàn！ nǐ yě lái zhè jiā fàn diàn chī fàn？
A： duì， wǒ hé wǒ de jiā rén lái chī fàn。 wǒ de péng you shuō zhè lǐ de Guǎng dōng cài hěn hǎo chī。
B： nǐ de bà ba mā ma yě lái le ma？

A： méi yǒu， tā men xǐ huan zài jiā chī。 wǒ de hái zi men lái le。 nà shì wǒ de lǎo gōng， xiǎo Sūn； nà gè shì wǒ de dà ér zi， xiǎo bǎo， jīn nián 7 suì le； zhè shì wǒ de xiǎo nǚ ér， Xiǎo bèi， jīn nián 5 suì le。
B： nǐ men yī jiā sì kǒu rén zhēn xìng fú！ hái zi men dōu shàng xué le ma？
A： dà ér zi qù nián shàng xiǎo xué le， xiǎo nǚ ér míng nián shàng xiǎo xué。
B： nǐ lǎo gōng yě huì shuō Hàn yǔ ma？
A： hā hā， dāng rán， tā shì Zhōng guó rén！
english_paragraphs: A: Teacher Wang, long time no see!
B: Long time no see! Do you come to this restaurant to eat too?
A: Yes, my family and I are here for dinner. My friend said the Cantonese food here is delicious.
B: Are your parents here too?

A: No, they like to eat at home. My children are here. That is my husband, my grandson; that is my eldest son, Xiaobao, who is 7 years old this year; and this is my youngest daughter, Xiaobei, who is 5 years old this year.
B: Your family of four is so happy! Are the children in school?
A: My eldest son went to elementary school last year, and my younger daughter will go to elementary school next year.
B: Does your husband also speak Chinese?
A: Haha, of course, he is Chinese!

B: Your family of four is so happy! Are the children in school?

A: My eldest son went to elementary school last year, and my younger daughter will go to elementary school next year.

B: Does your husband also speak Chinese?

A: Haha, of course, he is Chinese!
